The meeting is at 14:00 Tuesday in Nairobi, which is UTC+3. To find UTC time, subtract 3 hours: 14:00 − 3 = 11:00 UTC on Tuesday.

Sao Paulo is UTC−3, so to convert from UTC to Sao Paulo time, subtract 3 hours: 11:00 − 3 = 08:00.

Since no date boundary is crossed (11:00 UTC minus 3 hours stays within the same day), the day remains Tuesday.

ANSWER: Tuesday 08:00
